changes.summary: Replace arbitrary module and source-line caps with semantic architecture fitness checks.
Adopt stable sentence-case CI display names and the immutable shared naming verifier.
Require structured dispositions for non-blocking findings from new review assignments while preserving legacy evidence.
Allow process producers to require numbered consumer issues from an owner-selected repository before starting a change.
Require canonical production-engineering assessments in new plans and independent reviews without open-world keyword inference.
Distribute and validate one public pull-request evidence hierarchy with distinct review outcomes and a completion gate, without execution-only reviewer identities.
Generate canonical draft release pull requests and trigger publication only from the release authorization manifest.
Require new independent reviews to classify process-improvement scope and link shared gaps to a durable issue.
